Hi Grace,

Thanks again for walking through the commitment tiers yesterday. Procurement has a few gating items we need to lock before we can issue the blanket PO:

- We require an escrow arrangement for the committed credit pool that is released on milestone triggers (quarterly usage thresholds).
- PO must include the following custom fields: project_code, entity_code, and po_reference (our AP system needs these to auto-map invoices).
- Invoice cadence: consolidated monthly invoice per legal entity; cut-off day should be the 20th of the month.
- Net terms: standard request is Net 60 for our vendor base, but we can consider Net 45 if there is evidence of early-pay credit release tied to the escrow schedule.

Attached is our PO template (HealthBridge_PO_Template.xlsx) for your finance and legal teams to review. Can you confirm Redwood can support: (a) escrowed credits with DocuSign escrow exhibit, (b) custom PO fields mapped on your invoices, and (c) monthly consolidated billing with a 20th cutoff window?

If you prefer a brief call to align with finance/legal, I can loop in our AP lead.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Strategic Sourcing
HealthBridge

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear note and the template. Quick answers up front: yes on PO field mapping, yes on consolidated monthly invoices, and we have two workable patterns for the credits/escrow ask.

Options we can offer:
1) Escrow + milestone release (preferred for larger multi-quarter commitments)
   - Redwood places committed credit balance into a custodial escrow with release triggers at each quarter close (we can mirror the milestone language in an escrow exhibit).
   - Invoices issued monthly; credits are applied against invoices and any remaining committed balance is reconciled after each quarter.
2) Holdback + early-pay credit (simpler operationally)
   - We bill monthly, Redwood retains a 10% holdback of committed discount which is refunded/credited after each quarter once usage thresholds are validated.

Practical notes: our standard public terms support Net45. Net60 is possible but requires a formal credit review and approval from Finance (Vivek is cc'd). If HealthBridge needs Net60, we can run the credit assessment; alternatively, we can do Net45 + a 1.5% discount for early payment within 30 days to bridge the gap.

I've attached a brief summary of our billing and PO mapping options (Redwood_billing_options.pdf).

If that aligns, Ben can draft the commitment language for the SOW and Vivek can confirm the finance guardrails.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-minute call if useful.

—
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

- Commitment: 12-month committed annual spend of $750k across two legal entities.
- Escrow path: escrowed credit pool = $187.5k (25% of commitment) released quarterly on usage thresholds.
- Pricing bands: 10% platform discount at >= 75% committed utilization; 6% at >= 50%; 3% at >= 25%.
- Net term trade-off: Net45 + 1.5% early-pay credit vs Net60 with 2.5% discount reduction (finance approval required).

Operational asks to include on PO: project_code (string), entity_code (string), po_reference (string), billing_contact_email. Please ensure the PO file mirrors the HealthBridge template so our billing system can map automatically.

- If holdback: we document the holdback percentage and reconciliation cadence in the SOW and proceed with PO issuance.

Hi all — quick finance/legal checklist from our side.

If HealthBridge opts for the escrow arrangement we will need:
- Signed escrow exhibit (DocuSign link to follow) with milestone language clearly defined (we propose quarter-close release after usage validation).
- A primary AP contact and billing email to appear on the PO for remittance mapping.
- Completed credit questionnaire (I will send an internal form) — Net60 requires the credit review to reduce receivable risk.

If we do the holdback model instead, operational cadence is lighter:
- Redwood issues consolidated monthly invoice with the 20th cutoff as you requested.
- 10% holdback of the committed discount is retained; we reconcile and apply refunds/credits at quarter close.
- Net45 can be approved without additional paperwork; Net60 requires credit sign-off (timeline for approval is ~7–10 business days after questionnaire).

I've attached our draft Escrow SLA to accelerate conversation (Escrow_SLA-draft.docx). Once Samira confirms the preferred path and provides the PO contact, Legal and Finance will prioritize the paperwork.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference
